dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the members of the Lower Elwha Klallam Tribe and administrative responsibilities of the Department of the Interior.
dimensions.evidence: takes approximately 1,082.63 acres of specified lands in Washington into trust for the benefit of the Lower Elwha Klallam Tribe

dimensions.assessment: Transfers specific federal acreage into tribal trust status and expands the tribe's reservation boundaries.
dimensions.evidence: Land taken into trust shall be part of the tribe's reservation.

dimensions.assessment: Exempts the land transfer from appraisal and valuation requirements under federal law, with no explicit dollar amounts stated.
dimensions.evidence: shall not be subject to any requirements for valuation, appraisal, or equalization under any Federal law.

dimensions.assessment: Applies a targeted land-in-trust transfer and specific management and gaming restrictions for a single tribe and defined geographic area.
dimensions.evidence: approximately 1,082.63 acres of Federal land generally depicted as 'NPS Parcels to be Transferred to Tribe'

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory land transfer and reservation status.

missing_information: Economic valuation or loss of federal asset value associated with the transferred land.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill takes approximately 1,082.63 acres of federal land in Washington into trust for the Lower Elwha Klallam Tribe, adds it to their reservation, and prohibits gaming on the land.
